verdict.rationale: Docs show the product is designed to be used without manual API-key management (e.g., built-in model selector in docs-16, one-click download/sign-in flow in docs-36/probe-2) implying free personal-account access, but hands-on community reports directly contradict a smooth free tier: users hit 'Model quota limit exceeded' minutes after starting despite a marketed 'generous rate limits' free plan (comm-4), and others report that even a verified Google account with an active AI subscription and payment method still lacks the required 'Antigravity entitlement' to use the free tier, with account-wide bans for related usage (comm-17, comm-19, comm-20). missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing the personal-account sign-in/free-tier flow, and independent confirmation that free-tier access works reliably without entitlement gating or quota cutoffs.
